newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia September CPI up 3.6 pct year-on-year.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia September CPI up 3.6 pct year-on-year.

text.p: Malaysia's Consumer Price Index (CPI) for September expanded by 3.6 percent from the same month a year ago, the national Bernama news agency said on Thursday.
The index also rose 3.6 percent for the first nine months of the year, against the corresponding period last year, Bernama quoted a Statistics Department report as saying.
The department said the CPI growth for September was due to price increases in almost all goods and services, except clothing and footwear which decreased by 0.7 percent.
Food, gross rent, fuel and power accounted for 76.2 percent of the overall increase, it said.
